scope: Test a derived rolling continuum branch against longer finite photon trains in the same optional 1D Hamiltonian. No physical scale calibration, matter-clock derivation, capture, gravitational response or observational validation.
interpretation: Agreement with an analytic branch is measured, not imposed as a pass criterion. Finite deterministic packets and startup transients are not a proof of continuum stability or cosmic stationarity. All source photons exist initially with total energy power times source_duration.
